biomarkers.name: AFP (alpha-fetoprotein)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Limited diagnostic adjunct; no longer sufficient alone for diagnosis. Monitoring for recurrence. AFP ≥400 ng/mL predicts benefit from ramucirumab (REACH-2) in second line

biomarkers.name: PIVKA-II / DCP (des-gamma-carboxy prothrombin)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Complementary to AFP; used in Asian practice and surveillance/diagnostic panels

biomarkers.name: PD-L1
biomarkers.clinical_use: Not required for atezolizumab + bevacizumab first-line (IMbrave150) or tremelimumab + durvalumab (STRIDE, HIMALAYA)

biomarkers.name: CTNNB1 (β-catenin)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Wnt-pathway activation may predict reduced IO benefit ('cold' tumours)

biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.clinical_use: Common in HBV-associated HCC; adverse prognostic association

biomarkers.name: TERT promoter mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Most common somatic alteration; supportive molecular feature in hepatocarcinogenesis, but not a routine standalone diagnostic test

biomarkers.name: Etiologic markers: HBV, HCV, alcohol, MASH
biomarkers.clinical_use: Guides surveillance, treatment of underlying disease (antivirals), and may influence systemic therapy outcomes; etiologic differences in IO responsiveness remain under active study

biomarkers.name: ALB
biomarkers.clinical_use: Recurrent somatic alteration described in HCC genomic series

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Hepatocyte-like cells arranged in trabecular, pseudoglandular, or solid patterns; bile production diagnostic
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Edmondson-Steiner grade I-IV; also WHO differentiation grading

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Two dominant classes are often described: 'immune-inflamed' (more likely to respond to IO) vs 'immune-excluded' / immune-cold (including many Wnt/CTNNB1-activated tumours)
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Dysplastic/cirrhotic background often present; scirrhous variant has dense fibrous stroma; steatohepatitic variant has fat-laden background

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Hepatocytes or hepatic progenitor cells; some HCCs may arise from hepatic stem/progenitor cells with mixed hepatocellular/cholangiocellular potential
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Endoderm — foregut (hepatic diverticulum from primitive foregut)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Trabecular/plate hepatocellular architecture (Hep-Par1+, arginase-1+, glypican-3+, AFP+ in subset) reflecting hepatocyte lineage
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma (cHCC-CCA) reflects biphenotypic differentiation; CTNNB1-mutant HCCs have a distinct Wnt-driven immune-cold phenotype
